description: This source file implements intra-slice scheduling logic for a 5G NR scheduler, including functions for computing resource allocations, managing UE candidate groups, and scheduling UL/DL transmissions with HARQ and PDCCH considerations.

classes.name: intra_slice_scheduler::slice_ue_group_scheduler
classes.description: Helper class for managing UE candidate groups within a slice, including filling DL/UL candidate groups based on slice UEs.

classes.name: intra_slice_scheduler
classes.description: Main class implementing intra-slice scheduling logic, resource allocation, HARQ handling, and candidate management.

methods.name: compute_expected_pdschs_per_slot
methods.description: Calculates the expected number of PDSCHs per slot considering TDD/FDD configurations and resource limits.

methods.name: fill_ue_dl_candidate_group
methods.description: Fills the list of DL UE candidates for a slice.

methods.name: fill_ue_ul_candidate_group
methods.description: Fills the list of UL UE candidates for a slice.

methods.name: fill_ue_candidate_group
methods.description: Core method to populate UE candidate list based on slice UEs and scheduling policies.

methods.name: intra_slice_scheduler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the scheduler with configuration, resource allocators, metrics, and logger.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Updates the scheduler with the current slot point for scheduling.

methods.name: post_process_results
methods.description: Performs post-processing after scheduling, such as updating metrics.

methods.name: dl_sched
methods.description: Performs downlink scheduling for a slice, including retransmissions and new transmissions.

methods.name: ul_sched
methods.description: Performs uplink scheduling for a slice, including retransmissions and new transmissions.

methods.name: create_newtx_dl_candidate
methods.description: Creates a DL candidate for new transmission if UE has pending data and resources are available.

methods.name: create_newtx_ul_candidate
methods.description: Creates a UL candidate for new transmission if UE has pending data and resources are available.

methods.name: max_pdschs_to_alloc
methods.description: Calculates maximum number of PDSCHs that can be allocated in a slot for a slice.

methods.name: max_puschs_to_alloc
methods.description: Calculates maximum number of PUSCHs that can be allocated in a slot for a slice.

methods.description: Updates the VRB bitmap of used resources for downlink based on slice UEs and current allocations.

methods.name: update_used_ul_vrbs
